headline: KLA results beat Wall Street estimates, but shares fall on high investor expectations
summary: KLA Corp on Tuesday beat fourth-quarter revenue estimates and forecast first-quarter revenue above Wall Street expectations, ‌but its shares fell 9% in extended trading as the ‌results failed to meet investor expectations. The company's shares have risen more than 57% so ​far this year, driven by higher demand from foundries and memory-chip makers expanding capacity to support the data-intensive requirements of generative AI applications. KLA provides process control and yield management systems, which are critical for identifying and correcting ‌defects during the semiconductor manufacturing ⁠process.

headline: KLA CORPORATION REPORTS FISCAL 2026 FOURTH QUARTER AND FULL YEAR RESULTS
summary: KLA Corporation (NASDAQ: KLAC) today announced financial and operating results for its fourth quarter and fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. KLA reported GAAP net income of $1.36 billion and GAAP diluted earnings per share ("EPS") of $1.04 on total revenues of $3.66 billion for the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026. For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, KLA reported GAAP net income of $4.83 billion and GAAP diluted EPS of $3.66 on total revenues of $13.58 billion.

headline: Apple Reclaims the Crown as a China Chip Scare Sinks the Semis
summary: Wall Street opened strong on a sharp oil selloff but faded as a report on Chinese progress in advanced lithography rattled ASML and the entire semi complex. Apple leapfrogged Nvidia to reclaim its title as the world's most valuable listed company, right as the Fed, big-tech earnings and Q2 GDP move into focus.
